title: The last layout changes are inconvenient for small devices
symptom: The user reports that recent layout changes (Material Card View and Material Button) take up too much space on small screens, making it hard to see the graph. They changed the margin-top from 4 dp to 1 dp to see the graph again, but the material buttons are still problematic.
cause: The layout changes introduced larger margins and material components that consume excessive vertical space on small devices.
fix: A workaround was to reduce the margin-top of the Material Card View from 4 dp to 1 dp. Additionally, a pull request (#1652) was made to change the former workaround margin for material buttons.
evidence_quote: I changed it from 4 dp to 1 dp so I can see the graph again
